major_stars.紫微: The Emperor star — leadership, dignity, status, a need to be respected; noble but can be aloof or proud.
major_stars.天機: The Strategist — intelligence, adaptability, planning, restlessness; clever, analytical, sometimes overthinks.
major_stars.太陽: The Sun — generosity, drive, brightness, public-spiritedness; warm and giving, can overextend or burn out.
major_stars.武曲: The General of Wealth — decisiveness, discipline, money sense, resolve; capable and tough, can be blunt or lonely.
major_stars.天同: The Child of Fortune — gentleness, contentment, enjoyment, emotional warmth; easygoing, can lack drive.
major_stars.廉貞: The Reformer — complexity, passion, principle, intensity; charismatic and disciplined, can be moody or rigid.
major_stars.天府: The Treasury — stability, management, generosity, conservatism; steady and trustworthy, can be cautious or possessive.
major_stars.太陰: The Moon — sensitivity, nurturing, intuition, aesthetics; tender and refined, can be moody or self-protective.
major_stars.貪狼: The Desire star — charm, versatility, appetite for life, sociability; magnetic and adaptable, can be indulgent.
major_stars.巨門: The Gate of Debate — eloquence, scrutiny, insight, scepticism; sharp and probing, prone to disputes or doubt.
major_stars.天相: The Minister/Seal — fairness, service, loyalty, diplomacy; supportive and dignified, can be indecisive.
major_stars.天梁: The Elder — protection, wisdom, integrity, caregiving; principled and steady, can be preachy or stubborn.
major_stars.七殺: The Commander — boldness, independence, decisiveness, a pioneering edge; powerful but restless and abrupt.
major_stars.破軍: The Vanguard — disruption, change, courage, reinvention; breaks the old to build the new, can be impulsive.

palaces.命宮: Life / Destiny palace — the core self, character, and overall fortune. Read this first.
palaces.兄弟: Siblings palace — siblings, close friends, peers, and how you bond with equals.
palaces.夫妻: Spouse palace — marriage, the partner, and the nature of your romantic relationships.
palaces.子女: Children palace — children, creativity, students, and your nurturing/legacy.
palaces.財帛: Wealth palace — money, earning style, and your relationship with material resources.
palaces.疾厄: Health palace — constitution, vulnerabilities, stress, and physical/emotional wellbeing.
palaces.遷移: Travel/Movement palace — the outer world, opportunities away from home, social standing abroad.
palaces.僕役: Friends/Subordinates palace — friends, colleagues, networks, and how others support you.
palaces.官祿: Career palace — work, profession, achievement, and public role.
palaces.田宅: Property palace — home, real estate, family environment, and material security.
palaces.福德: Fortune/Spirit palace — inner life, contentment, values, blessings, and how you enjoy life.
palaces.父母: Parents palace — parents, elders, authority figures, and inherited support or pressure.

mutagens.祿: 化祿 — fortune & flow: resources, opportunity, ease, and good relations come to this star.
mutagens.權: 化權 — power & authority: drive, control, capability, and assertiveness amplify this star.
mutagens.科: 化科 — fame & merit: reputation, recognition, learning, and refinement enhance this star.
mutagens.忌: 化忌 — obstacle & attachment: friction, fixation, loss, or lessons cluster around this star.

five_elements_note: 五行局 (e.g. 金四局) sets the rhythm of the decadal luck cycles (大限) — the number is the age the first decade begins around.
soul_body_note: 命主 (soul) and 身主 (body) are guardian stars: 命主 reflects the innate self, 身主 the acquired/later self.
